answers.moment: Near the end we talked about our fathers. Both of them have had a heart scare, mine two years ago. We talked about how you watch your parents differently after that. I learned his dad lives close to him and still goes up ladders.
answers.reason: Because it's the thing I worry about most and I don't usually say it to strangers. It felt like he actually understood it, not just being polite. That doesn't happen often, so it stayed with me.
